metadata.title: Chromium Fork Setup Documentation
metadata.architecturalNote: This context uses current project settings and can proceed in parallel with Phase 0.5. Should be updated with ADR-009 architectural guidance once Phase 0.5.0 completes.

story.iWant: comprehensive documentation and templates for setting up the Chromium fork
story.soThat: I can quickly onboard new developers and ensure consistent build environments across the team
story.tasks:
Task 1: Create comprehensive setup guide (AC: 1) - Research Chromium fork setup requirements across platforms - Document prerequisites (depot_tools, Python, Node.js, etc.) - Write step-by-step setup instructions for Linux - Write step-by-step setup instructions for macOS - Write step-by-step setup instructions for Windows - Add troubleshooting section for common issues - Include verification steps to confirm setup success - Add screenshots for complex configuration steps
Task 2: Create configuration templates (AC: 2) - Create .gclient.template with Toubkal repository configuration - Create args.gn.template with optimized build arguments - Add detailed comments explaining each configuration option - Test templates on all target platforms - Document template customization options
Task 3: Create build automation scripts (AC: 3) - Create scripts/setup-build.sh for environment setup - Create scripts/build.sh for build execution - Add platform detection and appropriate handling - Implement error handling and user feedback - Add progress reporting and status updates - Test scripts on all target platforms
Task 4: Ensure documentation quality (AC: 4) - Verify all code examples work as documented - Test all external links and resources - Review documentation for clarity and completeness - Apply Toubkal documentation style guide - Add table of contents and navigation - Include quick start section for experienced developers
Task 5: Verify privacy compliance (AC: 5) - Audit setup process for unsanctioned network requests - Document all external downloads and their purposes - Add privacy verification steps to setup guide - Ensure setup respects zero-telemetry-by-default policy - Document how to verify no data leakage during setup
Task 6: Create comprehensive test suite (AC: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5) - Unit tests for build scripts functionality - Integration tests for template configuration - E2E tests for complete setup process - Documentation tests to verify all examples work - Privacy compliance tests for network monitoring - Achieve 80% test coverage minimum

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
1. Complete setup guide created (AC: 1) - Comprehensive chromium-fork-setup.md with step-by-step instructions - Covers Linux, macOS, and Windows platforms - Includes troubleshooting section for common issues - Documents all prerequisites and dependencies
2. Configuration templates provided (AC: 2) - .gclient.template with Toubkal-specific configuration - args.gn.template with optimized build arguments - Both templates include detailed comments explaining each setting - Templates work out-of-the-box for new developers
3. Build scripts created (AC: 3) - scripts/setup-build.sh for automated environment setup - scripts/build.sh for consistent build execution - Scripts handle platform differences automatically - Include error handling and progress reporting
4. Documentation quality standards met (AC: 4) - All code examples tested and verified - Screenshots included for complex setup steps - Links to external resources verified and current - Documentation follows Toubkal style guide
5. Privacy compliance verified (AC: 5) - Setup process respects zero-telemetry-by-default policy - No unsanctioned network requests during setup - All external downloads explicitly documented and consented - Setup guide includes privacy verification steps

doc.title: Chromium Fork Setup Guide
doc.snippet: Comprehensive guide with step-by-step instructions for setting up Chromium fork on Linux, macOS, and Windows platforms. Includes prerequisites, depot_tools setup, and troubleshooting.

doc.title: Build Instructions
doc.snippet: Detailed build system documentation covering GN configuration, Ninja builds, and incremental builds with Siso. Includes platform-specific notes and troubleshooting.

doc.title: Build System Architecture Decision
doc.snippet: Architecture decision documenting the choice of Chromium's GN meta-build system and Ninja for Toubkal Browser builds, including rationale and alternatives considered.

doc.title: Browser Engine Architecture Decision
doc.snippet: Documents the decision to fork Chromium as the browser engine, including integration points, maintenance strategy, and security considerations.

doc.title: Testing Strategy
doc.snippet: Comprehensive testing guide covering unit tests, integration tests, E2E tests, and performance testing. Defines 80% coverage minimum and mocking strategies.

doc.title: Privacy & Ethics Policy
doc.snippet: Foundational privacy principles requiring zero telemetry by default, cryptographic auditability, and explicit user consent for any data collection.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Product requirements for build system, including deterministic builds, cross-platform support, and privacy-compliant tooling.

constraints.constraint: Follow Chromium build system patterns and conventions - use GN meta-build system, Ninja for compilation, and depot_tools for dependency management
Use deterministic build flags for reproducible builds - ensure same inputs produce identical outputs across different machines
Implement proper dependency management - use DEPS files for third-party dependencies and version pinning
Follow Toubkal coding rules for configuration files - use kebab-case for scripts, dot-case for templates, and proper naming conventions
Respect zero-telemetry-by-default policy throughout setup - audit all network requests and document external downloads
Ensure cross-platform compatibility - provide scripts and documentation for Linux, macOS, and Windows
Maintain 80% test coverage minimum - include unit tests for scripts, integration tests for templates, and E2E tests for setup process
Reference Phase 0.5.0 architectural guidance (ADR-009) once available - align setup documentation with defined Mojo IPC interfaces and integration patterns
Use current project paths: Project=C:\ToubkalBrowser, DepotTools=C:\depot_tools, Chromium=C:\chromium, GitHub=https://github.com/Ilyass-Motya/Toubkal.git
